firm_data.firm_name: The Louis D. Brandeis Center for Human Rights Under Law
firm_data.firm_description: The Brandeis Center's mission is to advance the civil and human rights of the Jewish people and promote justice for all. Through legal advocacy, research, and education, they advise and empower individuals, universities, and corporate entities to recognize and effectively address anti-Semitism.
notable_facts: The Brandeis Center utilizes the law to improve campus life for Jewish students, oppose anti-Israel boycotts, and prevent anti-Semitism in the workplace.
They conceived The “Marcus Policy,” which established that federal civil rights law protects Jews and members of other faiths when they are targeted due to their ancestry or ethnicity.
